normalized.description: IDA Ireland supports eligible client sustainability investments through its Green Capital programme. As part of IDA Ireland’s investment approval process for Green Capital projects, an independent technical assessment is required to review the technical basis of each project and to validate or re-quantify its expected environmental impact. To date, technical assessments have been completed by a number of different assessors. As the volume and range of Green Capital investments increase, IDA Ireland requires a more consistent and scalable framework to support these technical reviews. IDA Ireland is seeking to appoint one service provider with the capability to manage and deliver all IDA Green Capital Technical Assessment services covered by this RFT. These will cover pre-investment technical assessments and post-investment Measurement and Verification (M and V) assessments.

Procedure title: Arzneimittel-Rabattvertrag ab 01.10.2025 zur Wirkstoffkombination Naproxen & Esomeprazol im Rahmen eines Open-House-Verfahrens

normalized.description: This activity focuses on designing and optimizing Position, Velocity, and Time (PVT) engines specifically for LEO-based PNT systems. It aims to exploit the unique measurement diversity offered by LEO satellites, such as multipath whitening, Doppler utilization, and rapid LOS/NLOS transitions. Two approaches will be developed and compared: a conventional Kalman filter-based design and an AI/ML-based design to handle unexpected LEO measurement behaviours. The study will include state-of-the-art review, algorithm development, and benchmarking against traditional MEO GNSS-based engines. Hankintaan kuuluu myös hankittavien katsomoiden takuuaikainen huolto. Osa-alueen 2 hankintaan sisältyy optiona sähkömoottorit teleskooppikatsomoiden avaamiseen ja sulkemiseen.
